issue.title: Docs: Clarify API rate-limit responses
issue.body: Update the REST API documentation to explain HTTP 429 responses and Retry-After header semantics. Include a short client-side retry example. Documentation only, no service changes.

analysis.summary: Clarify the expected behavior for API clients receiving rate-limit responses.
analysis.proposed_change: Update the docs for HTTP 429 and Retry-After with a minimal example. Do not modify runtime behavior.
acceptance_criteria: API docs explain the 429 response and Retry-After header.
An example client retries after the documented delay.

tests.scenario: Review published API examples against the existing contract
tests.expected: Examples show valid 429 response handling and match existing behavior

analysis.reasoning: Documentation-only wording change; no application code changes requested.
